reference_boundary: OpenAI product docs are used only as official reference material. This manifest defines platform-neutral ADK command policy and does not include compatibility bindings.

contracts.scope: ADK-managed shell command approvals across supported agent runtimes
contracts.compound_shell_policy: split simple shell chains when the runtime can parse them; treat advanced shell features as a single high-risk wrapper invocation
verification: runtime rule check for each promoted rule
contracts.promotion_gate: No prefix rule can be promoted without positive and negative examples that prove the prefix is not broader than the intended command family.

contracts.scope: team or machine enforced command policy
contracts.compound_shell_policy: managed rules must remain restrictive when shell wrappers contain redirection, substitution, assignment, wildcard, or control flow
contracts.promotion_gate: Admin rules may narrow capability without project consent; project-local rules must not widen managed restrictions.
